sectors.name: T1exit andT2curve
sectors.observed: The short link after the right T1 leads into the quick left T2. Red-white kerbs have green painted outer strips, with broad grass and gravel beyond. The main grandstand recedes behind the car.

sectors.name: Longbackstraight andT4
sectors.observed: The long fast straight descends through grass and palms. Guardrail, mesh and distance boards define the approach to T4. The slow right apex has a broad green paved escape, with tan runoff farther out. Stands and pit buildings stay distant.

sectors.name: T5–7 infield

sectors.name: T8–9 approach tobowl

sectors.name: T10–12 longrightbowl
sectors.observed: The multi-apex right is continuous. Inside grass and red-white kerbs follow the arc, while green and red outer paint leads to broad tan gravel. Large spectator terraces and separate angular roof sections stand beyond the escape area.

sectors.name: T13–16 finalcomplex
sectors.observed: Sweeping changes lead into the final slow corner beside the main facilities. Grass, gravel and green paint surround the kerbs. The stacked pit roof slabs and blue glazed control tower should remain visible. Preserve the white pit entry fork markings.
